name: Contea di Sclafani
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Sicilian DOC for white and red wine. The white is at least 95% Catarratto, and the red is made from Nero d'Avola, Perricone or both in any proportion.
